tools.name: lookup_ip
tools.description: Look up one public IPv4 or IPv6 address and return its WorldIP profile: owner/organisation, ASN, country, region, city, CIDR, reverse DNS (PTR) and forward-confirmed DNS. IPv4 profiles include domains_hosted, a daily count of the domains hosted on the address from issued.live (a number, never the names). IPv6 profiles add version, prefixes and an rdns block that flags ISP-generated PTR names. Use it for a specific address; for the user's own connection, call whats_my_ip instead. Problems come back as a tool result with isError true and a one-line reason: a malformed address, a CIDR range or hostname, or a private, loopback, documentation or other reserved address (these have no public profile). Free and keyless, limited per calling IP to 60 calls a minute and 1,000 a UTC day (shared with the keyless JSON API); a limited call says when to retry.

ip.description: The address to look up, e.g. 8.8.8.8 or 2001:4860:4860::8888. One address only: not a CIDR range, hostname or URL. Surrounding spaces are ignored, and an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address (::ffff:8.8.8.8) is looked up as the IPv4 address it carries.

tools.name: whats_my_ip
tools.description: Return the public IP address your request reaches WorldIP from, with the same profile lookup_ip gives (owner/ASN, country, region, city, reverse DNS; IPv4 also domains_hosted). Use it when the user asks for their own IP, ISP or location; for any other address call lookup_ip. On a hosted or cloud MCP client this is the platform's outbound IP, not the end user's device. If that address is private or reserved, the result is only the ip and a note, with no profile. Takes no arguments. Free and keyless, limited per calling IP to 60 calls a minute and 1,000 a UTC day (shared with the keyless JSON API); a limited call says when to retry.
